# Glow

A soft colored halo around selected objects, like an outer glow in an image editor. Without a mask the halo surrounds areas brighter than the threshold.

<EffectDemo effect="glow" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { glow } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/glow';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
const hero = scene.getObjectByName('hero'); // the objects to select
composer.add(glow({ mask: { selection: [hero] } }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.color = '#5ad8ff'`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter   | Type                                                      | Default     | Range     | Description                                                                |
| ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- | --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `color`     | hex color (theme: [`accent`](/guide/holocss#theme-roles)) | `'#5ad8ff'` |           | Halo color.                                                                |
| `intensity` | number                                                    | `2`         | 0 – 10    | Brightness of the halo, in linear units (above 1 blooms with HDR effects). |
| `radius`    | number                                                    | `16`        | 1 – 64 px | How far the halo spreads.                                                  |
| `mode`      | 'outer' \| 'both'                                         | `'outer'`   |           | Halo only outside the selection, or over it as well.                       |
| `threshold` | number                                                    | `1`         | 0 – 8     | Without a mask: linear brightness that starts to glow.                     |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset   | Settings                                                           |
| -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `aura`   | `radius: 28`, `intensity: 1.5`                                     |
| `hover`  | `color: '#ffd166'`, `radius: 10`, `intensity: 3`                   |
| `danger` | `color: '#ff4d6d'`, `radius: 20`, `intensity: 2.5`, `mode: 'both'` |
| `soft`   | `radius: 40`, `intensity: 1`                                       |

Apply one with `glow({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Blur & glow · tracked as story X5.4 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass. It also renders its own intermediate passes before the merged pass.
- **Masks:** reads its `mask` itself rather than fading by it (see the description); any [mask kind](/guide/masks) works.
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 5.9 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/glow`, including the shared effect runtime.

### Selecting what glows

```ts
const highlight = glow({ preset: 'hover' });
highlight.mask = { selection: [hoveredMesh] };
```

The halo is a blur of the mask at half resolution, so it costs the same however many objects are selected. Texture masks work too; depth masks aren't used as a glow source.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Separable Gaussian blur of a selection mask, added as a colored halo.
